name: 几何雪花
description:
[W] Call Sign 
Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
[W] Ice Beam 30
Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
